v3.1.2 — Windows compatibility hotfix. Bug 1: soul.py subcommands (status/init/...) produced empty output on Windows Git Bash because os.execvp does not reliably propagate child stdout back to the parent shell — replaced with subprocess.run + sys.exit(returncode). Bug 2: soul_paths.py raised UnicodeEncodeError on Chinese Windows ('gbk' codec can't encode 🧬) because it was the only script without the UTF-8 stdout/stderr reconfigure guard introduced in v3.1.1 — guard added at module top, idempotent on import. No data/API/behavior change on macOS/Linux.

v3.1.1 — silent auto-migration to ~/.agent-commons/skills_data/soul-archive/ + Windows console safety. Data location is now uniformly canonical; legacy ~/.skills_data/soul-archive/ data is silently moved on next skill invocation, no prompt or flag. All 8 entrypoint scripts reconfigure stdout/stderr to UTF-8 to prevent UnicodeEncodeError on Windows PowerShell/cmd default cp936. Standalone scripts/soul_migrate.py removed (no longer needed). Docs (README/SKILL/PRIVACY/multi-device-sync) drop the 'two locations' story — single canonical path everywhere.

v3.1.0 — Agent Commons co-location + migration tool. Soul Archive now resolves its data dir dynamically: if ~/.agent-commons/ exists (you've joined the Agent Commons protocol), data goes under ~/.agent-commons/skills_data/soul-archive/ for unified backup/sync; otherwise it falls back to ~/.skills_data/soul-archive/ for standalone use. New scripts/soul_paths.py central resolver, scripts/soul_migrate.py opt-in migration with --dry-run/--rollback, and docs/multi-device-sync.md with privacy-layered .gitignore templates. All 8 existing scripts refactored to call resolve_soul_dir() instead of hard-coding paths. Standalone usage unchanged. First adopter of agent-commons v2.0 CONVENTIONS.md skills_data/ location.
Documentation refresh; explicit honesty fallback in Soul Chat
